evidence.name: DualFieldCleanupWithNullChecks

function_ir.summary: Two-field resource cleanup method. If the file-handle field at offset 0x10 is non-null it is closed via FileCloseWithLock and zeroed; if the buffer-pointer field at offset 0x128 is non-null it is released via FreeWrapper_7bcf and zeroed. Both releases are null-guarded; always returns 0.

operations.description: If the field at this+0x10 (file handle) is non-null, enter the close-and-clear block.
Call FileCloseWithLock(*(this+0x10)) to close the open handle.
If the field at this+0x128 (allocated buffer pointer) is non-null, enter the free-and-clear block.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf(*(this+0x128)) to release the allocated buffer.

unresolved: The struct owning offsets 0x10 and 0x128 is not proven; field roles (file handle and data buffer) follow callee names only.
The relationship between the two released resources and any ordering requirement is unknown.
